pages.name: Psionics
pages.html:
Psionics

Psionics: Psionics are extrasensory abilities that some people are gifted with.

  • PSI: Psionics is abbreviated to PSI. It functions as a reservoir of psionic strength points that decrease with use and slowly recover over time.
  • Psionic limitations: Most people that have the gift may only know of extremely limited applications and durations of use. However, when utilized at opportune moments, they can give a spacer an advantage.
  • Maximum PSI: The PSI score can never naturally exceed 15 (including drug enhancement). PSI max is also limited by never being higher than the combined sum of a character’s STR, DEX, END, and INT scores.
  • Using PSI: Using any known psionic talents will cost psionic strength points, which will decrease the current PSI score.
  • PSI recovery: PSI recovers at the rate of 1 point per hour of rest.
  • Psionics are controversial: Social stigmas or laws often govern the use of psionics. Many worlds have restrictions on them and frequently outright ban them.

Book p.114

pages.name: Am I Psionic?
pages.html:
Am I Psionic?

  • Psionic institutes: To unlock the potential of a person’s mind, they must seek out a hidden organization that practices psionics. Due to psionics being controversial, they are extremely difficult to find.

Psionic Testing: When a spacer finds a psionic institute, they must pay for an exam.

  • Examination: Costs 5,000cr and requires two weeks of time. A spacer can be examined for free if they make a case for training and succeed on a SOC check of 10+.
  • Psionic potential: Roll 2D but apply -1DM per four year interval after 22 (or -1DM per career term after the first in character creation). The result after modifiers is a spacer’s psionic strength (PSI).

Psionic Training: If a spacer has a PSI score of 1 or more, they may choose to seek training at the psionic institute.

  • Cost: The spacer must pay 100Kcr for training. If they don't have the money, they can choose to surrender material possessions equal to 95Kcr in lieu of the monetary cost.
  • Time: Training at an institute takes four months of continuous training.

Book p.114

pages.name: The Six Disciplines
pages.html:
The Six Disciplines

The Six Disciplines: There are six different psionic disciplines a spacer can learn in training.

  • Telepathy: The ability to detect, connect, and interact with another’s mind.
  • Clairvoyance: The ability to discern events occurring beyond the means of the normal senses.
  • Telekinesis: The ability to interact with the physical world without physical interaction.
  • Awareness: The ability to be fully aware and control of the spacer’s physical body beyond the norm.
  • Teleportation: The ability to transport physical objects or yourself between two locations instantly.
  • Special: This covers psionic talents beyond the scope of physical manipulation, allowing for abilities such as astral projection, bilocation, and other abilities the psionic spacer may wish to perform, at the referee's discretion.

All adepts at a psionic institute are exposed to each of the six disciplines and can choose in what order they undertake their training.

  • Limits of training: it is nearly impossible for any human to understand and perform all six disciplines.
  • Training penalties: For each discipline a spacer is trained in, they must demonstrate their potential to perform the talent in a special exam. The spacer incurs -1DM per discipline. For example, the first exam incurs -1DM, the second -2DM, etc.

The following is the roll needed to pass to learn the talent.

  • Telepathy: 5+
  • Clairvoyance: 6+
  • Telekinesis: 6+
  • Awareness: 7+
  • Teleportation: 9+
  • Special: 9+

On a success, the spacer has a Level 1 understanding of that talent.

  • Talent levels: All talents have different abilities that are only capable of being understood and performed at certain levels. A spacer can increase their talent level by rolling an EDU check of 8+ once a month. On a success, their talent increases by +1. A talent’s level cannot exceed the spacer’s maximum PSI score.

It is possible to pass an exam but not be able to perform the entry level ability if the spacer doesn't have enough PSI points. This can be temporarily offset by taking PSI-drugs.

Book p.114

pages.name: Performing a Psionic Talent
pages.html:
Performing a Psionic Talent

Performing a Psionic Talent: Any spacer that wishes to perform the talent must meet the following criteria.

  • Be the correct level for that discipline.
  • Have the required amount of PSI points to perform it.
  • Be within the correct distance to perform and have enough PSI points to project the talent the required distance.
  • Focused: Many abilities require the spacer to remain undisturbed for the duration of performing the psionic ability unless stated otherwise.

Psionic Ability Duration: All abilities will last for the duration listed with them.

Increasing a Level in a Psionic Discipline: Roll 8+ once per month to increase the spacer’s level in the discipline.

  • Requirement: The spacer must either have performed the discipline in the past month or have spent at least one week practicing, similar to studying for skill advancement.
  • New ability learned: If the spacer’s psionic discipline level increases to a level where they can perform a new talent, then it is inferred that they have discovered this new talent through practice and reflection.

pages.name: Telepathy
pages.html:
Telepathy

Telepathy: Telepathy is the discipline of intermind mental communication. It allows a person the ability to link their mind with willing or unsuspecting individuals.

  • Duration: A spacer can continuously perform telepathy but must spend the necessary PSI points per 10 second duration to maintain focus.

While this ability doesn’t require using PSI points to perform, it requires having at least one PSI point for it to remain active.
- Shield breaking: The shield can be shattered if an attacking psion is powerful enough. The attacking psion must roll 8+ with a DM equal to the difference in remaining PSI points between the attack and defender. If the defender has more points, the DM is negative, while if the Attacker has more PSI, then the DM is positive.		Constant0+

pages.name: Clairvoyance
pages.html:
Clairvoyance

Clairvoyance: This discipline allows the spacer to see and hear events happening that they themselves cannot see through normal means. To perform any clairvoyance ability, the spacer must state the location they are trying to see.

  • Range cost: See the Psionic Range chart to determine the additional cost of this ability depending on the distance of the focus.
  • Duration: A spacer can continuously perform clairvoyance but must spend the necessary PSI points per 10 second duration to maintain focus.
LevelPSI AbilityDescriptionDurationPSI Used
2SenseThis ability provides rudimentary features of the desired location, including basic shapes, locations and distances between them, but no clear visual details. For example, the spacer will be able to see the presence of people and what they are doing but not the identity of the person.10 seconds1+
3DirectionThe spacer determines an intended location, object, or person and will be able to know in which direction they are located as long as they are familiar with the intended target, such as by using a photo or if the spacer has been to the location prior. The PSI used must be unused PSI points in the PSI reserve equal to the range of the person/place/thing.ConstantRange cost
5ClairvoyanceAllows the spacer to remotely see activity currently happening.10 seconds2+
5ClairaudienceAllows the spacer to remotely hear activity currently happening.10 seconds2+
7Sensory ProxyThis ability allows the spacer to temporarily see and hear what someone is doing as if the spacer were themselves the target.10 seconds2+
9ClairsentienceAllows the spacer to both see and hear activity currently happening.10 seconds2+

pages.name: Telekinesis
pages.html:
Telekinesis

Telekinesis: This discipline allows the spacer to move physical objects by applying mental force. Telekinesis lasts for as long as the spacer is able to concentrate on the object, up to one minute of time.

  • Sight requirement: The spacer must be able to see what is being moved or be able to visualize the object and its intended target location. This can be direct sight or indirect, such as on a monitor, while engaging in clairvoyance, or through any other method, at the referee’s discretion.
LevelDescriptionDurationPSI Used
1Move 1g1 minute1+
2Move 10g1 minute2+
3Move 100g; Push/Pull1 minute3+
5Move 1kg; Telekinetic Force1 minute5+
8Move 10kg1 minute8+
10Move 100kg; Levitate Self1 minute10+
  • Push/Pull: Starting at level 3, the spacer can choose to decrease the amount of time from 60 seconds to act immediately to forcefully move something or someone quickly by doubling the PSI used. This allows for the spacer to push or pull things quickly without needing to focus. Items thrown through telekinesis at a living target inflicts damage equal to the spacer’s telekinesis level +1 for every 1kg the item weighs.
  • Telekinetic force: Starting at level 5, the spacer can also apply telekinesis to form a wave of force that emanates from their mind and focuses on a target, applying 1D (+1 per psi point spent) damage to the target on a successful 8+ INT roll. Apply environmental factors to the roll such as cover, etc. Damage gains a +1 equal to the amount of PSI used, and the spacer must spend at least 5 PSI points to perform this.
  • Levitate self: The spacer can levitate themselves and any equipment worn or held equal to 50kg or less, but may only move at normal walking speed. The spacer must end their duration of levitation on the ground, or they will immediately be subject to gravity once they stop focusing. However, the spacer can mimic short-term flight by spending double the amount of PSI needed to quickly move five times faster than walking speed for 10 seconds. The referee may require the spacer to make a roll of 8+ modified by their DEX and apply DMs if environmental factors may inhibit flight, such as weather, wind, hanging objects, etc.

Book p.117

pages.name: Teleportation
pages.html:
Teleportation

Teleportation: The discipline of teleportation is extremely difficult to understand and is demanding to learn.

  • Know destination: The spacer must visualize the full 3D environment they are teleporting to. This could include if they have been there before or if it is implanted into their mind by another psionic character. If the spacer lacks this knowledge, then they are making a Risky Teleportation.
  • Energy and momentum: Due to planets rotating and moving through space, it may be difficult for the spacer to determine the exact point of arrival. On a successful teleportation, roll 8+ along with INT mod. The spacer will incur a DM equal to the current speed band they are travelling at if in a vehicle and -1DM per 200m change in elevation from exit to arrival. A success indicates landing on your feet, while a failure indicates a displacement of 1D metres per failed step under 8 on a horizontal plane and D3 metres per step below 8 vertically.
  • Risky Teleportation: A spacer may attempt to teleport without a familiarity with their desired destination.
  • Risky teleportation check: Roll 8+ to succeed with any DMs from energy and momentum applied and any other environmental factors as determined by the referee. They can spend additional PSI to grant themselves +1DM per two points spent.
  • Failure: On failure, the spacer arrives a number of range bands away from their intended target equal to the failure effect. On a result of 2 or less, the spacer teleports into an area that would immediately kill them, such as the deep ocean, kilometres below the planet's surface, kilometres in the sky, or in the middle of outer space between their two locations, as determined by the referee.
LevelPSI AbilityDescriptionDurationPSI Used

9Personal, EquippedThe spacer can teleport themself along with any worn and carried items, equal to their unencumbered weight limit.InstantRange cost

pages.name: Special
pages.html:
Special

Special: The Special Talent category encompasses any other psionic ability that doesn’t easily fit into the other disciplines or could be considered more complex. This category is open-ended, and the referee should feel free to develop other psionic abilities if desired.

LevelPSI AbilityDescriptionDurationPSI Used
1SuggestionInfluence an NPC by suggesting they say or do something you desire. Use the NPC reaction table, but gain +4DM for the suggestion. On a success, they follow your suggestion for a minute (or six combat rounds).1 minute4
3Post-CognitionSee an event that has transpired in the location the spacer is standing in. They will be able to see and hear what has occurred. The amount of PSI used is determined by how far back in time the spacer desires to look:
1 hour, 2 PSI
1 day, 4 PSI
1 week, 8 PSI
1 month, 10 PSI
1 year 12 PSI
1 decade, 14 PSI
Based on the desired range, the only events that pop up will be anything of interest to the spacer, based on what they are looking for. However, they will only be able to experience up to a 10 minute interval of time of relevant or notable events that took place in the desired span of past time they are searching.		10 minutesSpecial
4Astral ProjectionThe spacer leaves their body and is able to travel to their desired location and move around the target location and normal walking speed but without being restricted by obstruction. During this period, the spacer’s body is in a comatose state and is helpless. While astral projecting, the spacer is unaware of anything happening to their physical form and will only return when willing.10 minutes4+
6BilocationThis is an advanced version of astral projection. Bilocation allows the spacer to physically exist at the same time in two locations. However, only one physical form is real, while the other is a manifestation. The manifestation can still interact with physical space as long as the spacer is focused. The second form vanishes once the duration ends or the spacer’s real self is distracted or harmed.1 minute6+

The target can attempt to repel the invading psion, succeeding on an 8+ with END mod applied, plus any +1DM per two PSI spent if they are psionic. They may make this attempt every 10-second round their mind is occupied. The attacking spacer must maintain focus to perform mind-body occupation.10 seconds4+
